title: Permanently open a service in firewall
summary: Allow traffic for a specific service (like HTTPS or SSH) in a firewall zone permanently.

steps.explain: Add a service to the permanent configuration of a specific zone. This does not take effect until you reload firewalld.

placeholders.name: ZONE
placeholders.description: The firewall zone to modify (e.g., public, home)

placeholders.name: SERVICE
placeholders.description: The service name to allow (e.g., https, ssh, http)

steps.explain: Reload firewalld to apply the permanent changes immediately.

rollback.explain: Remove the service from the permanent configuration.
Reload firewalld to apply the rollback.

warnings: Opening ports exposes your system to network traffic. Only open services you explicitly need.
Ensure you know the correct zone for your network interface before modifying it.
